caption: The drawing depicts a stylized interior wall with a centrally positioned fireplace. The fireplace has a blue rectangular frame with an interior of reddish-brown bricks and two gold-colored andirons inside. The wall is off-white and is decorated with symmetrical, repeating botanical patterns. The main decorative elements above the fireplace are three rows of green stylized palm trees, alternating with circular and fan motifs in green and black. At the center, above the fireplace, is a single willow-like tree drawn in a light green color. Vertical rows of small green foliage elements are spaced between the palm trees. The lower section of the wall, flanking the fireplace, includes a large green double-leaf motif and two black-and-green circular motifs, one on each side. The area immediately above the fireplace and continuing horizontally along the wall is bordered by a green, leafy vine pattern contained within a band. The uppermost part of the wall is bordered with an arched pattern containing green and black flower-like shapes, alternating with stylized fans and geometric elements. The entire composition uses pale green, dark green, black, reddish-brown, blue, and off-white in a repeating and balanced decorative scheme.
title: Wall Stencil
